episodes.title: Evangelion: Shadows Rise
episodes.logline: In a world on the brink of destruction, a new season of battles begins as the Evangelion team faces unknown shadows.
episodes.synopsis: As the world struggles with the aftermath of the previous battles, a new threat emerges in the form of mysterious shadows. The Evangelion team must unite once more to face these unknown enemies and protect humanity.
